[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1ok[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Catch phases that end without closing their bead, and stop agents [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]from working the wrong bead[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A phase agent that misreads its own bead ID is warned or refused at[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the CLI. A single-turn phase that ends with its bead still open is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]classified stranded and raises one wait alert. A follow-on epic [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]proposed after its bead closed no longer nests under it.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Let the stranded-work collector see single-turn sessions[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]stranded-root-members[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stranded-root-members: add an agent_name candidate-filter field to the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-core artifact index and query agent_session OR agent_name from the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stranded collector, so a session's root member (agent_session null) is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]no longer reported unknown/no_records.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Raise one wait alert per stranded bead a live waiter is [/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]blocked on[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]stranded-bead-wait-alert[dim] · [dim][/dim]after stranded-root-members[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stranded-bead-wait-alert: make wait_checks classify the unclosed beads [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that live waiters block on through a targeted, TTL-cached stranded-work [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]collection, and upsert one deduplicated, self-dismissing notification [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per stranded bead with its cause and relaunch command.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Warn or refuse when an agent targets a one-segment near-miss [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]of its assigned bead[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]assigned-bead-near-miss[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]assigned-bead-near-miss: detect, inside SASE agents, bead IDs that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]differ from the assigned bead by one inserted or deleted non-trailing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]segment; banner the read output, refuse close/open per the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]near_miss_mutation decision, and tighten the phase and task work [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prompts.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop plan propose from parenting new epics under an [/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]already-closed bead[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]closed-parent-stamp[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]closed-parent-stamp: skip the automatic parent_bead stamp in sase plan [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]propose when the proposing agent's active bead is already closed, so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]follow-on campaign epics are top-level instead of growing the ID one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]segment per batch.[/#D7D7AF]
